items.statement: Expect UAE subsidiary to gradually commence operations and contribute to long-term growth in coming years
items.quote: As the digital situation continues to stabilize, we expect to gradually commence operations and are confident that the UAE subsidiary will play an important role in expanding our international footprint and contributing to our long-term growth in the coming years.

items.statement: Plan to have totally indigenous 3D printer by 2028
items.quote: We are also actively working on the 3D printer project as well, so that we have a totally indigenous 3D printer by 2028.

items.statement: Export demand improving across key geographies as international markets stabilized
items.quote: As several international markets gradually stabilized during the year, we witnessed improving demand across key export geographies, providing renewed momentum to our overseas business.

items.statement: EBITDA margin 38.6% for FY26, moderated marginally from prior year
items.quote: The company maintained healthy profitability with an EBITDA margin of 38.6%, a PBT margin of 36.0% and a PAT margin of 26.7%.

items.statement: Q4 FY26 EBITDA margin improved to 40.87% despite revenue challenges
items.quote: Our focus on operational efficiency resulted in further improvement in margins during the quarter. EBITDA margin improved to 40.87%, PBT margin to 38.38% and PAT margin to 28.61%.

items.statement: Revenue from operations grew 13.9% to INR71.81 crores in FY26
items.quote: Revenue from operation increased by 13.9% to INR71.81 crores compared with INR63.03 crores in financial year 2024-'25.

items.statement: Domestic business grew 9%, export business grew 17.58% in FY26
items.quote: The domestic business maintained a stable performance with growth of 9%, while our export business recorded a growth of 17.58% during the year.

items.statement: US business grew 37.58% in FY26 including Axiodent and private labeling
items.quote: Last -- in comparison to last year, we have grown the business in U.S. 37.58%, which is included with Axiodent and as well as private labeling.

items.statement: 3D printing resins revenue grew 40.5%, 3D printer sales grew 162% in FY26
items.quote: You can see around 40% increase in the revenue this year on 3D printing resins. We are also actively working on the 3D printer project as well, so that we have a totally indigenous 3D printer by 2028.

items.statement: Established wholly owned subsidiary in UAE during FY26
items.quote: Another important initiative during the year was establishment of our wholly owned subsidiary in the UAE.

items.statement: Traditional capacity utilization at 67-68%, new production lines at 18-20% utilization
items.quote: As far as the capacity utilization is concerned, the traditional capacity, the company is working at a capacity utilization of, say, around 67% to 68% of its total installed capacity. And if the company works with total installed capacity, the total turnover would be around, say, INR125 crores. And as far as the new production line is concerned, which includes digital dentistry, resin, disinfectan

items.statement: Started commercialization of Disinfectant business as new vertical in FY26
items.quote: During this year, we started commercialization of our Disinfectant business. This marks the beginning of new vertical that aligns well with the rising demand for hygiene-driven products in the dental and medical settings.

items.statement: Oradox oral care sales down 2% due to US MoCRA and Dubai export disruptions
items.quote: We are down by 2%. That is because we couldn't export to the markets in the US. US started a new portal called the Modernization of Cosmetic Regulations Act. And the Dubai Municipality and after the war, we couldn't export substantial amounts.

items.statement: Compete with MNCs like Ivoclar, Dentsply on price advantage from low India production cost and high import duties, plus OEM for 3-4 big companies
items.quote: A major competitors must be like companies like Ivoclar, Dentsply, 3Shape and all these things. There are two ways to do this. The cost of production in India is so low and the import duties are so high, they can never beat us on price. And the quality surely since we have good quality management certificates that proves the quality. Second, by doing OEM for this, we presently OEM for around 3 or

items.statement: Oradox products registered with US MoCRA and Dubai Municipality for cosmetic products
items.quote: We have also registered our products with the MoCRA in the United States as well as the Dubai Municipality registrations for the cosmetic products have also been completed.

items.statement: Expect at least 40% of dental office procedures to have digital workflow in next 5 years
items.quote: We expect in the next 5 years, at least 40% of all procedures, which are done at the dental office will be having a digital workflow.

items.statement: Geopolitical tensions, war, shipping disruptions affected Q4 FY26 revenue and export dispatches
items.quote: the fourth quarter was relatively more challenging from a revenue perspective due to high geopolitical tensions, war-related developments and disruption in global shipping and supply chain, which affected customers' ordering patter ns and export dispatches

items.statement: Middle East conflict delayed UAE subsidiary commercial operations
items.quote: While the commencement of commercial operations was delayed due to geopolitical tensions and conflict in the Middle East, which impacted overall business activity, the underlying market opportunity remains strong.

items.statement: Expects 15-20% revenue growth in FY27
items.quote: So, our target is to achieve 15% to 20% growth in the next year.

items.statement: Targets INR1,250 crore turnover by 2030
items.quote: Actually, we have yesterday we have uploaded our vision of 2030 with the INR1250 crores turnover in the by 2030 we have made the vision like for next 4 years.

items.statement: FY26 capex was INR60 crore plus; FY27 target is INR50 crore plus
items.value: INR60 crores plus ... INR50 crores plus
items.quote: Capex in the financial year '26 is INR60 crores plus and the financial year '27 we are also targeting INR50 crores plus to have our growth engine

items.value: around 100 plus vehicles ... same we are targeting
items.quote: So around 100 plus vehicles we have added last year and same we are targeting in the next financial year.

items.statement: Secured 3-year (extendable to 5) dedicated contract for 100 vehicles from Haldiram Nagpur
items.quote: So, they have given us the contract for three year extendable to five years for the 100 vehicles dedicated supply to them.

items.statement: Formed 50:50 JV Carbonlite Logistics with Baidyanath Group for LNG vehicle fleet; operations to start within a month
items.quote: So we have made a separate logistics company for that name is Carbonlite Logistics Private Limited. That is 50% subsidiary of the AVG and 50% subsidiary of the

items.statement: Q4 FY26 EBITDA margin expanded 349 bps to 19.66%; full-year EBITDA margin improved to 19.31%
items.quote: EBITDA stood at INR34.72 crores, increasing 45.21% year-on-year, while EBITDA margin expanded by 349 basis point to 19.66%.

items.statement: Fuel escalation clauses in contracts pass through diesel price increases within 1-2 weeks
items.quote: But maximum customers' contracts includes the fuel escalation clause. So the all the contracts are having the rider and the percentage of the diesel consumption is mentioned in the contract.

items.statement: Entered rail-based liquid logistics; targets 8-10 trains by 2030; currently 180 container tankers, aiming for 1,800
items.quote: And sixth one is our liquid logistics. Because liquid logistics business is much better because of very few companies are into this business. Hence we have entered into the last year and we will grow in a fast manner with the 8-10 trains by 2030.

items.statement: Targeting growth in FMCG, beverage, liquor, steel, cement, pharma, chemical, industrial plant, solar power sectors
items.quote: Now we are entering into beverage, liquor industry, steel, cement, pharma, chemical, and industrial plant and solar power industries.

items.statement: One-time lease reversal gain of INR21.19 crore in Q4 FY26 due to Ind AS 116 adjustment on contract pre-closure; tax not leviable as expenses already deducted in prior years
items.quote: This is a normal business income because we had entered into a long-term contract for different requirement on lease basis. So in certain cases where the lease is long-term, so we need to create some Ind AS provisions.

items.statement: Vehicles earn from day one; 80-90% loan funded; EMI paid from vehicle earnings over 5-6 years
items.quote: My vehicle is earning from the day one. So we are taking maximum 90%, 80% loan from the bank or NBFCs. So my truck is earning from the day one and we are paying the EMI.

items.statement: Industry growth estimated at 15-20% annually
items.quote: And more or less our industry growth is around double-digit in around 15% approximately, 15% to 20%.

items.statement: Q4 FY26 results delayed due to detailed audit reviews and branch consolidation
items.quote: The delay was only due to the procedural and audit related requirement. As our business has grown, the audit process has become more detailed and require additional reviews.

items.statement: Acquired land parcel in Tahliwal, Himachal for warehousing to enhance North India presence
items.quote: We also advanced our infrastructure expansion with the strategic acquisition of land parcel in Himachal, in a place called Tahliwal, for warehouse purpose.

items.statement: Launched CNG-powered vehicle corridor with Nestle India and Ashok Leyland under long-term contract
items.quote: we reinforced our commitment to sustainable logistics through our collaboration with Nestle India and Ashok Leyland for deployment of CNG-powered vehicle

items.statement: Vehicle purchases funded 80-90% via bank/NBFC loans; EMI serviced from vehicle earnings
items.quote: So we are taking maximum 90%, 80% loan from the bank or NBFCs. So my truck is earning from the day one and we are paying the EMI.

items.statement: Announced acquisition of 100% of Nagarro at €1.27B enterprise value (€81/share cash), 140% premium to undisturbed price, 1.27x EV/Revenue, 9.12x EV/EBITDA
items.quote: Persistent has agreed to acquire 100% of the Nagarro shares at an enterprise value of €1.27 billion based on an €81 per share in cash; a premium of 140% to the undisturbed closing price on June 25-26 and 94% to the 3-month volume weighted average price.

items.statement: Secured 21% stake via SPA from major shareholder; management board committed to tender shares; both boards support transaction; minimum acceptance threshold 50%+1 share
items.quote: It has already secured 21% stake in Nagarro via share purchase agreement from the major shareholder. Management Board has already expressed their interest to tender their shares into the open offer. Both Nagarro boards fully support the transaction and have signed a business combination agreement.

items.statement: Transaction fully funded via committed €1.4B bridge financing from Barclays at Euribor + 175-250 bps (4.1%-4.8%); Persistent parent provides €1.4B corporate guarantee
items.quote: This will be completely funded through a committed bridge financing from Barclays. The interest rate is going to be Euribor plus a margin of 175-250 basis point. At this point of time that translates somewhere in in the range of around 4.1%-4.8%.

items.statement: Combined Net Debt/EBITDA leverage 1.9x-2.5x depending on open offer acceptance; expected to reduce to 1x by FY2030
items.quote: The leverage, that is the Net Debt over the combined EBITDA, is going to be 1.9 times-2.5 times based on how much will be the open offer Persistent Systems Limited acceptance. So, at 50% plus 1 share to 100%, it is expected to reduce down to 1X by FY2030

items.statement: Transaction expected to be Cash EPS accretive and Reported EPS accretive in Year 1 excluding transaction expenses
items.quote: The transaction is expected to be Cash EPS accretive as well as Reported EPS accretive in Year 1 if you remove the transaction expenses that will be incurred in the first year.

items.statement: Signed strategic long-term agreement with existing US tech leader: $125M+ annual revenue, $650M+ over 6.5 years, net new deal, accretive from Q2
items.quote: So, from this deal perspective, this is a net new deal which will add roughly about $125 million plus on an annual basis and overall for the period of the contract it will be roughly about $650 million plus over 6.5 years.

items.statement: Combined entity margins expected to be maintained or improved; Nagarro EBITDA margin 13.9%, Persistent 15.6%; cost synergies to be reinvested in growth
items.quote: So, long answer, but to summarize, we believe we can maintain the margins and better them.

items.statement: Goodwill and intangibles split ~70/30; other intangibles amortized over 8 years
items.quote: Goodwill and Other Intangibles put together, so we are anticipating it will be roughly around 70% Goodwill and 30% Other Intangibles. And those Other Intangibles will be amortized over a period of 8 years.

items.statement: Combined entity: 46,000+ employees across 40+ countries; $2.9B+ revenue; Persistent $1.654B FY26, Nagarro €1B (~$1.14B) TTM
items.quote: Bringing the group together, we will be 46,000+ team members globally spread across 40+ countries. It will be a 2.9 billion dollar+ powerhouse focused on forward-looking technologies.

items.statement: Large deal: end-to-end product engineering and support for significant product portfolio globally; employee transitions involved; minimal ramp-up
items.quote: And from that perspective, we are responsible for end-to-end product engineering and product support for a significant portfolio of products globally.

items.statement: Nagarro adds 180+ $1M+ logos with high quality; <10 customer overlap; top Nagarro customer <$50M vs Persistent top 4 avg >$100M; significant cross-sell opportunity
items.quote: Now, if you have 180 logos, which are 1 million plus, and they are very good quality, and the highest customer may be less than $50 million. If we bring the tenets of Persistent, if we bring together the minds to be able to mine those customers, we actually don't need to hunt for any other logo.

items.statement: Revenue mix shift: Combined North America 62%, Europe 22%, Rest of World 16% vs Persistent 81% NA, 8-8.5% Europe; Nagarro 35% NA, Europe-heavy
items.quote: North America for the combined organization becomes 62%, Europe becomes 22%, Rest of the world, which includes places like Australia, Singapore, Japan, Israel and others, become roughly about 16%.

items.statement: Complementary capabilities: Persistent adds CX, Nagarro adds ERP/SAP, OpenAI accredited reseller, strong consulting; combined AI-forward engineering
items.quote: Similarly, from an OpenAI perspective, they are one of the few organizations which are accredited resellers to OpenAI and they have a forward deployed engineering practice around OpenAI.

items.statement: Nagarro management committed to stay; founders Manas, Vikram, Annette, Prateek Aggarwal on board; cultural fit via India-Europe corridor (13,500 of 18,500 Nagarro staff in India)
items.quote: 13,500 of the team members in Nagarro today reside in India, 1,500+ reside in the rest of the world. So, from a cultural perspective they are already a very heterogeneous company into a homogeneous Nagarro.

items.statement: Regulatory approvals needed: BaFin (Germany), RBI (India), other countries; BaFin offer document clearance 10 working days to 2 weeks; AGM last week July 2026 for shareholder approval
items.quote: In the next 4 weeks, we'll be filing our documents with the regulatory authority BaFin here in Germany. And they will take around 10 working days to two weeks' timeframe for us to get back and clear the offer document.

items.statement: Transaction expected to close Q4 CY2026 or early Q1 CY2027; open offer acceptance period 4 weeks + 2 weeks extension
items.quote: Based on the current anticipation of various regulatory approvals that are expected, we expect this transaction to close sometime towards the Q4 of Calendar Year 2026 or early Q1 of Calendar Year 2027.

items.statement: Nagarro had BaFin queries on carve-out from Allgeier and accounting principles; management confident issues are procedural with no performance impact
items.quote: So, they have got two set of queries. One was related to the time that they basically were carved out of Allgeier. The second is about how they have taken the accounting principles and so on. And we have done the diligence on both, we are confident that those issues are more answering BaFin rather than any issues that have any impact on the company's performance.

items.statement: Persistent 5-year revenue CAGR 23.9%; Nagarro 5-year CAGR 18.4%; combined target: industry-leading growth, $5B aspiration by FY31
items.quote: If you look at the last five years in an industry where others have not grown, we have grown disproportionately. From our last five years CAGR perspective, we are at 23.9%.

items.statement: Large deal margins "fairly healthy" and accretive from Q2; not at company average but acceptable; T&M model evolving with AI but not dead for next few years
items.quote: And yes, it will be accretive - revenue & margin from Q2 onwards. And from that perspective, margins are fairly healthy. It is not necessarily, you know, large deals like this don't come at the margins at the company average, but a company is always a sum of parts.

items.statement: Persistent moved from CapEx to OpEx model for working capital funding; will bring best practices to combined entity to improve cash flow and service debt
items.quote: And, you know, we have moved away from a lot of CapEx model to an OpEx model of working, funding our working capital. A lot of these things will help us in terms of supporting our cash flow and ensuring that we remain in the positive and comfortable zone.

items.statement: Combined entity positioned as 2nd largest digital engineering player globally, 7th largest India-listed tech services; scale enables seat at table for large global bids
items.quote: We would, as a combination, look to be the 2nd largest digital engineering player globally, 7th largest in terms of technology services company from an India listed landscape.

items.statement: No QIP planned; may consider private equity participation at asset level for deleveraging; no share swap due to public-to-private dynamics in Germany
items.quote: We don't intend doing any QIP, just to be clear for everyone. We don't intend diluting our stake at this point in time. We may look at if there is a merit in deleveraging by having a private equity or some other participation at the asset level.

items.statement: No domination/profit-loss transfer agreement (DPLTA) for 2 years; Nagarro runs independently with Persistent control; squeeze-out timing flexible
items.quote: We will have the agreements in place to drive synergies and be able to make impactful change in their decision making, working with them. That is the way we are looking at it. And that's the way mature transactions in the European public-to-private transactions work.

items.statement: Nagarro EBIT margin CY25 10.9%, Q1 CY26 12.1%; new CFO Prateek Aggarwal expected to improve financial rigor; Persistent confident of margin uplift
items.quote: So, the EBIT for CY25 for Nagarro is 10.9%. For Q1 CY26, it is 12.1%. And they recently brought on a CFO. For the longest period of time, they had run the CFO organization, not necessarily in the most regimented ways.

items.statement: AI transformation wave driving growth; both companies "engineering first" culture; Nagarro designed for digital transformation, now pivoting to AI transformation
items.quote: And with this in mind, many years ago we designed the company around digital transformation optimizing it for digital transformation work and we were able to ride that wave of growth for many years and today we are designing the company and moving the company and preparing the company for the AI transformation wave.

items.statement: Nagarro revenue flat 2 years with margin pressure; stock down 85% from peak; management distraction from take-private attempt cited as cause; Persistent track record gives confidence in turnaround
items.quote: If you look at our own track record of Persistent, we have grown from the time we went IPO at about 17.5% plus CAGR. If you look at the last five years in an industry where others have not grown, we have grown disproportionately.

items.statement: Management expects similar EBITDA and PAT margins to continue in FY27, targeting higher PAT margin than current ~10%
items.quote: In terms of margins, we expect the similar margins to continue. Vishal: So that means 10%? You're targeting 10%? Farrel Arora: Yes, we are targeting higher on that. There are other opex costs etcetera that also need to be, you know, streamlined

items.statement: Creator economy growing at 25-30% CAGR globally; management optimistic about sustaining healthy growth medium to long term
items.quote: The creator economy is growing at a CAGR of 25% to 30% globally. The it continues to expand really rapidly. Our brand relationships are deepening, new businesses like you said that's scaling well, and international markets are opening up.

items.statement: Revenue grew 42.5% YoY to INR84.22 cr in FY26; growth driven by deeper wallet share, higher campaign volumes, new clients, international expansion
items.quote: For financial year '26, revenue from operations stood at INR84.22 crores compared to INR59.12 crores in financial year '25, representing growth of approximately 42.5% year-on-year.

items.statement: Intangible assets under development stable at INR4.68 cr; AAGE edutainment app development resumed, targeting launch in current FY
items.quote: In terms of the intangible asset, the AAGE that you are speaking about, that was put on hold while there were so many other key projects that the company was doing including the IPO itself. However, in this current financial year, we would be resuming the development as well as launching the product.

items.statement: Team of over 100 professionals; manage 100+ exclusive creators; executed 2000+ campaigns; work with 500+ brands
items.quote: Today we work with over 500 brands, have executed more than 2,000 campaigns, manage over 100 creators exclusively, and have built a team of over 100 professionals.

items.statement: Growth driven by deeper engagement with existing marquee clients, cross-selling ChtrSocial and Studios, higher wallet share; no formal net revenue retention disclosed
items.quote: Over the years we've built great relationships with marquee brands, leading brands in the country and increasingly they are trusting us with larger, more integrated mandates. And that's a reflection of the numbers which you see. So we've seen a healthy increase in the wallet share from our existing clients at a bare minimum.

items.statement: IPO significantly strengthened balance sheet; net worth increased to INR70.06 cr as of FY26
items.quote: The IPO has significantly strengthened our balance sheet with net worth increasing to INR70.06 crores as of financial year 26.

items.statement: QYOU Media and Chatterbox exploring accretive M&A opportunities; public vehicle status enables M&A not possible in private sector
items.quote: There's a tremendous amount of M&A activity taking place in the creator economy today. We believe that one of the primary opportunities for Chatterbox and for QYOU Media is because we exist as a public vehicle, there are M&A opportunities that don't exist in the private sector.

items.statement: AAGE app development was put on hold due to IPO priority; now resuming development with launch targeted in current FY; monetization model still to be validated
items.quote: Our immediate priority was and is to use technology to create competitive differentiation for our core businesses. That's why we are really heavily investing ourselves into building our own full-stack platform. Over time, if we see opportunities to commercialize certain capabilities as a more of a standalone product or platform, we would certainly evaluate them.

items.statement: ChtrSocial and Studios have highest margin contribution; Represent seen as scalable with fixed margins but growing absolute dollar value
items.quote: In terms of margins, yes, ChtrSocial and our production arm essentially has the highest margin contribution and we continue to see this going forward as well. In terms of scalability, we see Represent being a good scalable business because the more exclusive creators we add, the more stronger pipeline of business it provides us.

items.statement: ChtrSocial expected to double revenue in upcoming months; brands consolidating social media management with integrated partners driving wallet share growth
items.quote: From a revenue mix perspective, we believe and we expect it will continue to increase its contribution over time because more and more wallet share as we keep biting on from brands, so the larger revenue spends and the budgets which they part for social media management will be factored into us. So yes, I mean, to give a metric, I wouldn't pin down X percentage growth which we expect, but we absol

items.statement: Core services order bookings grew from INR 299 crores in FY22 to INR 734 crores in FY26 at ~25% CAGR
items.quote: Order bookings have grown from INR 299 crores in 2021-2022 to INR 734 crores in 2025-2026, representing a CAGR of approximately 25%.

items.statement: Other OEM segment order growth increased from INR 162 crores to around INR 320 crores
items.quote: We are also seeing strong progress in the other oOEM segment, which is very unique for your company, where order growth has increased from INR 162 crores to around INR 320 crores.

items.statement: EBITDA improved from a loss of INR 251 crores in FY23 to positive INR 277 crores in FY26
items.quote: Our EBITDA, which was once reflected a loss of INR 251 crores in FY 2023, has crossed into positive territory, reaching INR 277 crores in FY 2026.

items.statement: Bank guarantee exposure reduced by INR 1,364 crores over two years
items.quote: We have shed INR1,364 crores in bank guarantee exposure over two years, untethering our capital from historical burdens.

items.statement: Liquidity position shifted from a deficit of INR 66 crores in 2023 to INR 880 crores by March 2026
items.quote: Similarly, our liquidity position has shifted from a deficit of INR 66 crores in 2023 to a robust INR 880 crores by March 2026, an eighteen -fold improvement in our cash position.

items.statement: Long-term ICRA credit rating improved to BBB+ with stable outlook as of June 2026
items.quote: We have also seen an improvement in our long-term ICRA credit rating to BBB+ with a stable outlook as of June 2026.

items.statement: Dividend declared in 2026 reflecting restored financial strength
items.quote: The declaration of dividend in 2026 further reflects the progress made in restoring the financial strength and the stability of the company.

items.statement: Proposed demerger of Durgapur business to JSW Energy on a going concern basis effective 1st July 2025
items.quote: Under the proposed Scheme of Arrangement, GE Power India Limited will demerge the Durgapur business unit to JSW Energy Limited.

items.statement: Share entitlement ratio of 10 JSW Energy shares for every 139 GEPIL shares approved by independent valuers
items.quote: For every 139 fully paid equity shares of GE Power India Limited, shareholders will receive 10 fully paid-up equity shares of JSW Energy.

items.statement: Existing GEPIL shares remain unchanged; shareholders gain direct equity in JSW Energy without dilution
items.quote: shareholders' existing number of shares in GEPIL will remain unchanged. And I repeat, the existing number of shares in GEPIL will remain unchanged.

items.statement: Durgapur facility utilization limited to service work and non-coal activities with average loss of INR 27 crores per year from 2023-2025
items.quote: During the last two years, from 2023 to 2025, there has been significant underutilization of its capacity, and this has resulted in an average loss of approximately INR 27 crores per year being booked in GEPIL.

items.statement: Five-year manufacturing services agreement with JSW Energy secures reserved capacity at pre-agreed schedules and pricing
items.quote: A five-year manufacturing services agreement with JSW Energy has been put in place to secure reserved capacity at a pre-agreed schedules and pricing.

items.statement: Concurrent efforts to establish independent supply chain progressing well with full independence targeted very soon
items.quote: concurrent efforts to establish an independent supply chain are progressing very well, with full supply chain independence targeted to be achieved very soon.

items.statement: Net worth grew more than eight-fold from INR 57 crores in March 2024 to INR 483 crores by March 2026
items.quote: We have seen our Net Worth grow more than eight-fold in just two years, climbing from INR 57 crores in March 2024 to INR 483 crores by March 2026.

items.statement: Expanded presence across international markets including Saudi Arabia, Turkey, Austria, UAE, Malaysia, Indonesia, and Morocco
items.quote: expanded our reach in the third-party fleet or oOEM segment, and increased our presence across international markets including Saudi Arabia, Turkey, Austria, UAE, Malaysia, Indonesia, and Morocco.

items.statement: Focused on high margin, cash accretive opportunities with faster cash conversion cycles since 2024
items.quote: Since 2024, we have focused on high margin, cash accretive opportunities with faster cash conversion cycles.

items.statement: Updated FY27 semaglutide pen sales guidance to 6-7 million pens due to supply disruption
items.quote: So naturally, because we are going to lose these months, that's why I mentioned, instead of what we could sell in this period of time, we will sell 6 to 7 million , in addition to what we sold already until now. So the range is between 6 to 7 million for fiscal '27.

items.statement: Previous guidance assumed sales in July-October now unlikely due to validation failure
items.quote: Yes, because before that, we assumed that we will sell during July, August, September, and October, and now, unlikely that we'll do that, that's why we initiated this clarification to the market and updated the market.

items.statement: Demand remains strong and unchanged; no shortage of demand for semaglutide pens
items.quote: Nothing has changed. Unfortunately, if we had 15 million, we could supply that also. So, there is no shortage of demand, and I don't see shortage of demand also going forward.

items.statement: Commercial supply to OneSource expected to resume in October after validation batches
items.quote: Assuming success, we can resume commercial supply in October to OneSource and then move from there. The 6 to 7 million pens that I mentioned is assuming supply of commercial quantities to the market from November onwards.

items.statement: Captive fill-finish facility timeline delayed by a few months but plans remain valid
items.quote: No, all the plans stay valid, we just have to move. Naturally, also, our facility needs to be supplemented with our API. This API will come only after validation, so the plans will just have to shift for the time o r duration that we will resolve this issue

items.statement: Partners informed of supply disruption; some have alternatives, relationships maintained
items.quote: Yes, obviously we updated all of them today, the same as we are updating you. Some of them have alternatives, some of them don't. We agreed with them that they need to do whatever is good for them, but we are committed to resolve it and to resume partnership.

items.statement: EBITDA margin target of 20%+ unchanged despite near-term volume miss
items.quote: So we are on the same pace and nothing has changed beside this event. So, all the stuff that we have discussed during our NDR, as well as with you guys remain the same.

items.statement: Impurity is degradation product detected in formulation during scale-up validation batch
items.quote: It's the impurity that comes from the API that degraded in the formulation. So you detect it when you do the testing to release the batch. In the formulation, it was detected, and it was out of spec.

items.statement: Root cause is process and reaction related in API manufacturing, not raw material or equipment
items.quote: It is to do with the process and the reaction of the API.

items.statement: Fix requires parameter tweaks to control impurity, no equipment change needed
items.quote: To the best of my understanding, no, it will not require that. It's required to tweak the parameters to control that impurity.

items.statement: No regulatory filing changes or agency notifications required for this process adjustment
items.quote: So first, Kartik, there is no need to inform any agencies. There is no change of specs or change of regulatory filing.

items.statement: No product recall needed as failed batch never shipped to market or customers
items.quote: That understanding is correct. I am mentioning it again. No recall. It's a batch. We tested it. We found one of the impurity out of specs and this batch was never shipped to a market and never shipped to any customer, therefore no recall is needed.

items.statement: Validation failure halts all API manufacturing including small scale until process re-validated per GMP
items.quote: It has nothing to do with the cost here. It's about GMP. If you are failing a validation, you cannot continue. So, you have to control the process as per GMP and commitment to GMP and quality.

items.statement: Alternate API supplier qualification underway but approximately one year away
items.quote: So, first we are qualifying another supplier, but the timelines, as I mentioned to Neha, I believe it was her question, it will take time. It's about a year away.

items.statement: Long-term partnership with OneSource confirmed; no plan to exit relationship
items.quote: We are committed to be with OneSource actually for long term. We will have also our backup facilities. But we are committed to a relationship with OneSource, and they are committed to our relationship.
