items.statement: AESL PPAs have no termination for convenience clauses, similar to SECI PPAs
items.quote: these contracts are on the basis of the SECI PPA, the grander PPAs. And it is --there is no termination on convenience per se in those contracts.

items.statement: Surpassed 20 GW operational renewable capacity milestone, India's largest and fastest greenfield addition
items.quote: We surpassed 20 GW milestone, making it India's largest and fastest greenfield renewable capacity addition.

items.statement: Current run-rate EBITDA for operational portfolio INR17,000 crore
items.quote: So, our current run-rate EBITDA for the operational portfolio is about INR17,000 crore.

items.statement: Strategy shift: de-risk merchant capacity via long-term C&I PPAs with AESL, focus on execution and operational excellence
items.quote: Exactly. So, what we have, we have taken off the risk of merchant capacities and the risk thereof, ups and downs. And, considering the recent tariffs, which were there on the long-term PPAs, this is the same return profile we have signed off with the Adani Energy.

items.statement: AESL contracted ~4 GW generation from AGEL; all merchant/BESS capacity to be tied up with AESL
items.quote: today morning Adani Energy had a call where they mentioned that about 4 GWs of generation is contracted by them from Adani Green.

items.statement: Rooftop solar growth (8 GW last year) not seen as disruptive to utility-scale demand due to evening/night peak requirements
items.quote: we don't foresee that distributed generation of a rooftop is going to disrupt the overall market of energy requirement in this country. items.statement: Evaluating other very large sites similar to Khavda for future development
items.quote: Of course. Nikhil, we are seriously evaluating many large sites and are working on it. Khavda experience has been phenomenally good for us and given us the confidence of executing and operationalizing these large projects.

items.statement: Guided 22-23% disbursement growth and 17-18% AUM growth for FY27
items.quote: For the next nine months, we are committed to delivering our yearly commitment of 22% to 23% top line growth and that remains steadfast on disbursement and that moves to about 17%-18% on AUM.

items.statement: Medium-term target of sustainable 20% AUM growth
items.quote: These improvements give us confidence that Aavas is well positioned to accelerate growth and deliver sustainable 20% growth over the medium term.

items.statement: NIM expanded 22 bps YoY to 7.70% in Q1FY27
items.quote: Our NIMs expanded by 22 bps Y-o-Y to 7.70% during the quarter, supported by improvement in cost of borrowing coupled with our continued focus on risk adjustment pricing.

items.statement: Expect spread to fall below 5% for full year FY27
items.quote: I do believe that spread compression from the existing point will take spread to go sub-5%.

items.quote: Our cost-to-income ratio improved by 254 bps Y-o-Y to 43.7% in Q1FY27, driven by better cost efficiencies.

items.quote: Our one-plus DPD improved by 39 bps Y-o-Y to 3.76% in Q1, remaining comfortably below 5%. Gross Stage 3 improved by 11 bps Y-o-Y to 1.11% while net stage 3 improved by 13 bps Y-o-Y to 0.71%.

items.statement: Credit costs at 24 bps, well within guided range
items.quote: Credit costs stood at 24 bps, well within our guided ranges.

items.statement: Confident of maintaining ROA and ROE guidance despite spread compression
items.quote: Reasonably confident to make sure that the ROE and ROA that we have planned for the year remains where it is, even if slight compression does take place on the competitive environment.

items.statement: AUM grew 15.4% YoY to Rs 239.3 billion; monthly AUM addition improved nearly 50% YoY
items.quote: Our AUM grew by 15.4% Y -o-Y to R s. 239.3 billion as of June end. Encouragingly, our monthly AUM addition improved by nearly 50% Y-o-Y during the quarter, enabling us to achieve in three months what previously took close to five months

items.statement: Branch network expanded to 440 across 15 states; will continue investing in branch expansion
items.quote: During the quarter, we expanded our branch network to 440 across 15 states. We will continue to invest in branch expansion to further deepen and diversify our presence.

items.statement: PLR reduced by 10 bps in June 2026, cumulative 25 bps since March 2026
items.quote: During the quarter, we implemented an additional 10-basis point reduction in our PLR, effective June 2026, taking the cumulative reduction of 25-basis point since March 2026 and passing on the benefit for the interest of the customer.

items.statement: Repayment rates spiked to 19%+ in April-May but normalized in June; BT-out rate tapered down
items.quote: We did see a small uptick in the early part of the fiscal opening, which is April and early May, in specific segments, especially interest rates upwards of 14%, small ticket. But as we close the quarter in the month of June, it has rallied bac k to its usual

items.statement: ROA improved 25 bps YoY to 3.19%, ROE improved 78 bps to 13.34% in Q1FY27
items.quote: Our ROA improved by 25 bps, Y-o-Y to 3.19% and ROE improving by 78 bps to 13.34% in this quarter.

items.statement: Targeting doubling productivity per resource from Rs 8-10 lakh to Rs 20-22 lakh within two years
items.quote: We look at productivity per resource deployed on the field. So, there could be large branches, small branches, there from an average of about Rs. 8-10 lakhs productivity per resource, we are looking at doubling this to at least Rs. 20 to 22 lakhs per resource deployed on the field

items.statement: RBI circular on repossessed asset classification under evaluation; will implement changes if required
items.quote: Renish, currently this is under evaluation, and we will ensure that if any change must be made, we will make it happen

items.statement: Proactive policy changes in February for segments affected by West Asia conflict and potential rainfall shortfall; monitoring tractor sales rebound
items.quote: Towards the same, in the early part of February, proactively the teams have made certain policy changes looking at the macro environment, certain segments, which would be affected by both the ongoing West Asia Conflict as well as the ensuing expectation of shortfall of rainfall.

items.statement: Net worth Rs 52.2 billion, CAR 44.66%, significantly above regulatory requirements
items.quote: We remained well capitalized with a net worth of Rs.52.2 billion and a capital-to-risk weighted assets ratio CAR of 44.66%, significantly above the regulatory requirements.

items.statement: Net worth compounding at 16% YoY driven by internal accruals
items.quote: Our net worth continues to compound steadily, growing at 16% Y-o-Y with the strength of our capital position driven by consistent compounding internal accruals.

items.statement: FY27 EBITDA guidance maintained at INR750-800 crore with sequential improvement expected
items.quote: Regarding your first point, whether we want to upgrade our guidance, we would like to stick with the same guidance of INR750 crore to INR800 crore.

items.statement: First half FY27 EBITDA expected around INR400 crore plus
items.quote: Sequential growth will be there. It will be in the similar range of what we have indicated when we met in the Bharuch a month back of roughly INR200 crore kind of an EBITDA in the first half will be around INR400 crore plus.

items.statement: Chemical industry demand resilient with stable volumes and firming pricing trend
items.quote: Despite continued geopolitical uncertainties in the Middle East, demand across chemical industry has remained resilient. Industry volumes have stayed stable. items.statement: Specialty Chemicals EBITDA margin at 26% driven by improved pricing and richer product mix
items.quote: EBITDA stood at INR139 crore with margins of 26%, benefiting from improved pricing and a richer product mix led by value-added CDMO and fine chemical offerings.

items.quote: We have a funnel of 100-plus molecules with INR3,500-plus crore of peak revenue potential with now 25-plus confirmed molecules, which will drive our growth in coming years.

items.statement: Confirmed CDMO molecules expected to contribute at least 25% of Specialty and Nutrition portfolio revenue
items.quote: Based on our earlier calculations and assuming we get full revenue from the big contract as per the agreement with the customer, the confirmed molecules were supposed to contribute at least 25% of our Specialty and Nutrition portfolio together here.

items.statement: New multipurpose plant on track for commissioning by end of calendar year 2025
items.quote: In the new multipurpose plant remains on track for commissioning by the end of current calendar year, further strengthening of our CDMO and Fine Chemicals growth road map.

items.statement: New niacinamide plant at 50% utilization, targeting 70%+ by end of FY27
items.quote: That plant was created for 5,000 tons annual capacity. items.statement: Pyridine plant running at 95%+ utilization
items.quote: Pyridine, as you all know, we are world leaders in pyridine and its derivatives. So we are running our plant currently also at 95% plus utilization level.

items.quote: EBITDA for the segment stood at INR57 crore, up 240% year-on-year and 163% quarter-on-quarter, driven by strong realization gains across the product portfolio and effective cost pass-through.

items.statement: Power and fuel costs increased due to higher volumes and Gulf crisis impacting LSHS/natural gas prices
items.quote: One, first reason is year-on-year, our volumes have increased and so has the quantity of power and fuel. items.statement: Specialty and Nutrition segments contribute 70-80% of total EBITDA mix

items.statement: 5 new molecules added in Q1 across pharma, semicon and personal care
items.quote: We added 5 new molecules in the last quarter across pharma, semicon and Personal Care.

items.statement: Pyridine pricing pressure from Chinese overcapacity in commoditized variants
items.quote: There are some commoditized variants of Pyridine, including the building block itself. The pricing pressure is more acute there because of the overcapacity in China.

items.statement: Remidex Pharma integration completed with encouraging traction from Tier 1 human nutrition customers
items.quote: On the M&A front, we successfully completed the integration of Remidex Pharma, and we are witnessing encouraging traction from Tier 1 human nutrition customers.

items.statement: Certified as Great Place to Work and ranked among top 50 manufacturing companies for FY27
items.quote: We were certified as a Great Place to Work and ranked among the top 50 manufacturing companies for FY27.

items.statement: Targeting INR100 crore lean savings in FY27
items.quote: On the operations and ESG front, we remain firmly on track, targeting INR100 crore of lean savings in FY27.

items.statement: Healthy export visibility and improving market dynamics supporting price increases

items.quote: Bulk of the increase is due to the logistic cost where we have been hit by the increase in the cost of logistics, both domestic and international, which is reflected there, which we were able to successfully pass on to our customers as is reflected in our increase in pricing.

items.quote: most percentage still 80-20 wise would be towards the merchant side

items.statement: Bag and fuel cost impact INR150 per ton in Q1 FY27, further INR70-80 increase expected in Q2
items.quote: Coming to the impact of bag overall impact of bag and fuel in this quarter because of geopolitical factors basically has been to the extent of INR150 per ton. And as I explained in the next quarter on a sequential basis, we expect a further incr ease in cost to the extent of INR70 to INR80 on account of geopolitical factors

items.statement: Trade blended cement prices soft in Central India for last year due to competition dynamics
items.quote: Unfortunately, Central India for whatever reason the prices have remained soft practically for the last one year, I would say, because of competition dynamics.

items.statement: Non-trade and OPC prices recovered significantly in North and Central, but trade prices did not follow
items.quote: the real gains have come during this period from the non-trade segment, industrial segment and OPC, which is again not our strong suit as a matter of strategy we have defocused from OPC because our capacity is as you know very high level of capacity utilization, so we focus primarily on blended.

items.statement: Packaging cost INR269 per ton in Q1 FY27 vs INR191 in Q1 FY26
items.quote: In this quarter it is INR269 per ton and in the previous quarter it was corresponding quarter of the previous year it was INR191.

items.statement: Bikram coal mine production 1.2 lakh tons in FY27, targeting 3.5 lakh tons in FY28
items.quote: See this year it will be about 1.2 lakh, next year we are planning to take it up to 3.5 lakh tons.

items.statement: Bikram coal to meet one-third of CPP coal requirement, may supply kiln later
items.quote: I can say that key one-third of the CPP coal requirement can be met through Bikram.

items.statement: KCal cost at Mukutban was 1.64 in Q1 FY27
items.quote: And KCal cost was 1.64.

items.statement: Higher limestone mining and mechanical mining in Rajasthan increased diesel costs
items.quote: Because of the higher clinker production , we did our own mining more, which cost of which goes to other expenditure, that's why your other expenditure seems to be higher Y-on-Y basis.

items.statement: Net debt at INR2,300 crores as of Q1 FY27
items.quote: Net debt INR2,300 crores.

items.statement: Government incentives accrued INR33 crores in Q1 FY27, full year guidance INR130-135 crores
items.quote: Incentive we have accrued INR33 crores.

items.statement: Delayed monsoon risk to Q3 demand if agricultural harvest impacted
items.quote: if there are monsoons hit later, one is one doesn't know how much it'll have a carryover impact into the third quarter if the agricultural scenario is not that good, if the harvest is not that good.

items.statement: Central India pricing risk if large players don't raise trade prices
items.quote: if the bigger players do not show any interest in raising the trade prices, we have to als o revisit some of our strategy, which we have thought, but that will depend on how the market pans out

items.statement: Full-year EBITDA margin expansion guided at 50-70 bps
items.quote: Our comparison always is versus the same quarter last year and versus the same quarter last year we've delivered 70 bps increase and which is in line with our guidance for the full year. So, we do maintain that this year we expect to deliver 50 bps to 70 bps of margin expansion.

items.statement: Growth businesses revenue growth guidance maintained at 30%
items.quote: Our guidance remains 30% growth. We will hit it out of the park once in a while, but Yes, broadly I would stay focused on the 30%.

items.statement: Capital Foods and Organic India growth aspiration 25-30%
items.quote: Yes, the answer to that question is 25% to 30% should be the new normal going forward.

items.statement: India tea volume growth guidance mid-single digit
items.quote: Our guidance remains mid-single digit volume growth and we do expect to deliver it in the short-to-medium term.

items.statement: Salt revenue growth target 5-7%
items.quote: We've always said mid-to-high single digits is the growth, so I would say 5% to 7% is a good number to target.

items.statement: Starbucks top-line growth expected close to high single digit
items.quote: On Starbucks, like I said, same-store sales growth was mid-single digit. That coupled with new store openings, I think you should expect a close to a high single digit top-line growth going forward.

items.statement: Consolidated revenue grew 12% YoY in Q1 FY27
items.quote: Overall, our consolidated revenue grew 12% with the India business delivering a 13% UVG.

items.statement: India tea volumes up 2% despite prolonged summer
items.quote: India tea volumes were up by 2% despite the prolonged summer, but revenue declined 4% because as tea costs came down, we've been passin g the benefit to the consumers

items.statement: Salt revenue grew 7% led by 7% volume growth
items.quote: Salt delivered 7% revenue growth, led by 7% volume growth despite the fact that in the month of June, we did take a price increase.

items.statement: Growth businesses grew 47% YoY and now 36% of India business
items.quote: Growth businesses grew 47% year-on-year and scaled to 36%. In terms of growth, I think this was the best ever quarter for the growth businesses for TCPL and they account for more than one-third of the India business now.

items.statement: Sampann grew 58% with broad-based volume growth
items.quote: Sampann grew 58%, and it was broad-based volume growth.

items.statement: RTD revenue up 41% with 38% volume growth
items.quote: RTD strong growth, revenue up 41% driven by 38% volume growth.

items.statement: Capital Foods and Organic India combined grew 35%
items.quote: Capital Foods and Organic India grew 35% combined.

items.statement: International business grew 3% constant currency, 16% reported
items.quote: International business grew 3% in constant currency, and overall, including forex, grew by 16%.

items.statement: US business delivered 7% constant currency growth, 7th consecutive quarter of share growth
items.quote: The U.S. business delivered 7% constant currency growth with, I think, the seventh quarter of consecutive share growth.

items.statement: Non-branded business declined 7% reported, 10% constant currency
items.quote: Non-branded business, as coffee prices came down in line with expectations, we saw it declining 7%. If I take constant currency, it was down by 10%.

items.statement: Starbucks revenue grew 11% YoY with mid-single digit same-store sales growth
items.quote: Starbucks had probably a very good quarter. Revenue grew 11% year-on-year. I have to say that we were cycling a slightly subdued quarter last year during the same quarter. But even without that, the same-store sales were in a healthy range.

items.statement: Consolidated EBITDA margin expanded 70 bps to 13.6%
items.quote: We delivered a 19% growth in EBITDA and margins expanded 70 bps to 13.6%.

items.statement: India segment margins improved on back of tea, offset by salt
items.quote: In terms of segment performance, we have seen India segment results improving on the back of improved margins in tea, of course some level of offset with salt, but by and large all businesses improving margins.

items.statement: International business margins flattish YoY
items.quote: International business is flattish over previous period and non-branded we saw some dilution in margin this quarter, largely on account of the correction in coffee prices and some FX related losses, but should come back in the subsequent quarters.

items.statement: Sampann margin expanded 150-200 bps YoY
items.quote: I think this quarter was close to a 150 to 200 bps of margin expansion over the same quarter last year.

items.statement: Salt price increase taken in June (Tata Salt MRP INR30 to 32)
items.quote: Broadly, Tata Salt, the orange bag moved from INR30 to 32 in terms of MRP, but value-added salts continue to deliver strong growth at a 13%.

items.statement: Calibrated price increases in tea taken in June
items.quote: We've already taken some minor price increases in the month of June, but if the trend persists, we will look at maintaining margins and taking pricing up.

items.statement: Cost inflation in growth segments will be passed on with time lag
items.quote: Yes, cost inflation very clearly, Abneesh, if it is -- if there is inflation, it will pass on. There might be a bit of a time lag between when it hits us and when we pass it on, but I would say broadly we would pass on the inflation and try to ensure that we maintain margins.

items.statement: Tea inflation currently 7-10%, peak cropping season just started
items.quote: Overall, we're seeing about 7% to 10% I would say inflation, that is for now, but the peak cropping season has just started to come in.

items.statement: Spices, dry fruits, cold-pressed oil seeing cost inflation
items.quote: For example, spices there is a severe inflation, similarly in dry fruits again because of the Iran crisis same issue and even in terms of cold-pressed edible oil.

items.statement: Coffee prices declining globally, proactive hedging mitigated impact
items.quote: The non-branded business, as I mentioned, in line with the coffee prices declining globally, was down 10% in constant currency, while solubles, which is primarily a pass-through business, declined 12%. Plantation declined 8%. But proactive hedging did help us mitigate some of the impact of coffee price corrections.

items.statement: Launched 14 new products in Q1 across health, wellness, convenience, premiumization
items.quote: Innovation fired on all cylinders, and we launched 14 new products during the quarter, and we've got a robust pipeline for innovation for the rest of the year.

items.statement: Capital Foods launched cup noodles, expanded chili oil, Korean noodle play coming
items.quote: For Capital Foods, the big expansion was noodles where we've finally got capacity together. We've launched cup noodles, we've expanded chili oil, and we're looking at -- let me put it this way, a slightly disruptive play in the Korean noodle space coming soon.

items.statement: Organic India expanding into supplements and organic pulses
items.quote: Organic India is an expansion into the supplement categories and we're looking at aggressive expansion of the organic pulses.

items.statement: Tata Soulfull grew 45%, launching protein muesli, expanding categories in 3-6 months
items.quote: Yes, so Tata Soulfull we grew at 45% for the quarter. It was a decent run. Tata Soulfull you will see a significant number of launches in the premium category so to speak and a little bit of expansion of the categories in which they play.

items.statement: RTD launched two Kombucha Zero variants for premium tea/coffee portfolio
items.quote: We also launched two variants of Kombucha Zero focusing on building out our premium RTD tea and coffee portfolio.

items.statement: Salt market share near 39%, ambition to cross 40% quickly
items.quote: We are now touching close to a 39% share in salt and our ambition is to very, very quickly cross the 40% mark.

items.statement: Tea mass premium and premium range outperforming bottom end
items.quote: Overall, even in our portfolio, our mass premium and premium range has done better than the bottom end of the portfolio, which has again increased market value realization if I may.

items.statement: Tea market share gained in relative terms over last couple of years
items.quote: We've broadly done better or gained in market share in relative terms over the last couple of years. And this quarter also we do feel from the numbers that we have from the big retailers as well as from the quick commerce players, we do think we've gained market share.

items.statement: Tata Soulfull strong in modern trade, e-commerce, quick commerce
items.quote: Tata Soulfull is primarily the strong channels are online and modern trade. It is available in all modern trade outlets and most of the high-end SAMT outlets. We are listed on all the quick commerce, e-commerce and that is a significant growth channel for us.

items.statement: Water business availability in 75% of country, real distribution at 40-50%, doubling capacity for next season
items.quote: We probably, we do sell water I would say in 75% or let me put it this way, we have availability in probably 75% of the country. But in real distribution, marketing, having got our act together, we're probably still at probably a 40% to 50%. So, we've got a still a long way to go.

items.statement: Evaluating in-house manufacturing for growth categories where scale and geography justify
items.quote: Where we see an opportunity where there is scale already in the category and there is value of it bringing it in-house, we will definitely evaluate. Now, the good and bad part is for most of these categories, the manufacturing capexes are not very heavy, so it should not be too difficult.

items.statement: Doubling down on water capacity for next season and possibly current second season
items.quote: One of the things is we are doubling down now to make sure that we add as much capacity definitely for next season, but even if possible, for the coming second season as well because we think the entire mix including execution is starting to fire up.

items.statement: ARS system ensures inventory days defined, primary-secondary broadly in line
items.quote: One of the things that we're laser-focused on is making sure our ARS system works and therefore inventory days are defined. It is inventory defined minus -- sorry, this thing is very, very clearly a calculated piece and therefore there is nothing to do with -- if you are mentioning the difference between primary and secondary, broadly in line.

items.statement: Proactive hedging mitigated coffee price correction impact
items.quote: But proactive hedging did help us mitigate some of the impact of coffee price corrections.

items.statement: Adjusted EPS INR4.67 after netting off brand amortization
items.quote: If I net that off, our adjusted EPS is INR4.67 per share.

items.statement: Net profit up 29% to INR427 crores
items.quote: PBT was up 27% and net profit was up 29% at INR427 crores.

items.statement: El Nino impact on tea could drive prices up, will pass through pricing
items.quote: If the single biggest impact of El Niño would be on tea if it happens, and if it happens prices go up, we will take up pricing to maintain margins

items.statement: West Asia situation dynamic, impacting cost environment
items.quote: As you would be aware that the West Asia situation has been fairly dynamic and cost and therefore has also been a bit dynamic.

items.statement: A&P spend at 6.1% of sales in Q1, stepped up sequentially and YoY
items.quote: We continue to put money behind A&P. Our Q1 -- was 6.1% behind almost all our brands.

items.statement: Joined Dow Jones World Index on Dec 4, 2025, CRISIL ESG score improved
items.quote: We are now a member of Dow Jones World Index, which we were incorporated on December 4, 2025. CRISIL, we moved from 61 to 67 and [ESG Risk] 62 to 68.

items.statement: Q2 revenue INR 2,681 cr, up 17.5% YoY and 7% QoQ despite passenger vehicle production drop
items.quote: As you can see, the revenue generation in the quarter was INR 2,681 crores, which is a clear 17.5% higher performance compared to last year. And over the preceding quarter, Q1'26 was a 7% higher performance.

items.statement: Q2 EBITDA INR 513 cr at 19.1% margin, up 14.3% YoY and 6.3% QoQ; PAT INR 337 cr at 12.6%
items.quote: we were able to deliver INR 513 crores at an EBITDA level in the quarter. And that is clearly a 19% better performance than last year and PUBLIC the preceding quarter as well, resulting in a profit after tax of INR 336 crores or INR 337 crores, which is about 12.6% profit after

items.statement: Highest value new business wins in industrial space in Q2 across cylindrical roller bearings, DGBBs, spherical rollers, TRBs and tri-plain bearings
items.quote: Bearings and Industrial Solutions has been a stellar performance in the quarter in terms of new business acquisitions. We have secured a lot of business opportunities and wins already in the quarter, particularly in the product portfolio of cylindrical roller bearings, DGBBs, spherical rollers as well, even TRBs for that matter and some of the tri-plain bearings for the raw material PUBLIC sector

items.statement: CY26 capex guidance INR 400-500 cr; INR 175 cr spent in H1, remaining INR 250-300 cr planned for H2 with INR 120-170 cr in automotive technologies and rest in B&IS
items.quote: So yes, in the remaining period, we are expecting that we will be consuming the remaining of INR 500 crores. And accordingly, the orders have been placed for the machinery for capacity PUBLIC and localization. The breakup is that close to INR 120 crores is in automotive – INR 170 crores is in automotive technologies and remaining in B&IS

items.statement: Capacity constraints at Hosur plant prioritizing OEM over VLS; addressing supply chain and local supplier development to feed both OEM and aftermarket demand
items.quote: We are trying to bring in more capacity so that we can feed both the OEM requirements and the aftermarket requirements. So invariably in a high-growth situation, the OEMs end up getting the priority and the VLS kind of takes a second preference.

items.statement: Input cost increases from LPG, propane, freight, fuel and 10% wage hike not fully passed through; indexation discussions with OEMs ongoing for H2 recovery
items.quote: Also to point out is some of the adverse situations that we faced with the LPG and the oil prices going up, our input costs have gone up, which is yet to be compensated by the customers, which we are still in discussions with them.

items.statement: Q2 working capital INR 2,029 cr, up due to planned inventory build-up for specific customer accounts and geopolitical situation
items.quote: As you can see in the Q2, our working capital has gone up to INR 2,029 crores. Clearly, this is a planned activity that we have lined up as we are building up inventories in some of the specific sectors for some of our specific customer accounts.

items.statement: Exports grew 24% YoY in Q2, 28% YoY in H1; driven by intercompany allocations from group localization in India and USD billing benefits; order book solid for year
items.quote: Yes, it is mainly because of intercompany allocations. So, what is happening is that in the process of localization many capacities are being built up here in India and mainly in Savli. And the group is trying to leverage on the capacities which are available in India.

items.statement: Export share cap at ~20% of revenue for natural hedging; aim to sustain 15-20% export growth but cautious due to geopolitical disruptions
items.quote: we never gave a guidance for the growth. We said our wish is to contain the exports up to about 20%. So, there could be in 1 quarter, a surge in orders. Hardevi Vazirani: Share of business we want to maintain

items.statement: Automotive Technologies revenue grew 33% YoY in Q2 (conventional ~20%, rest e-mobility); gained market share as PV production fell 8% QoQ but Schaeffler grew 3.6%
items.quote: Automotive Technologies, overall growth rate for -- if we see year-on-year quarter is 33.3%. And within that, both the conventional business has grown by close to 20% and the remaining growth is coming from e-mobility.

items.statement: KRSV (Koovers) Q2 revenue INR 79 cr; EBITDA negative due to INR 5.6 cr revenue recognition adjustment and INR 3 cr founders' bonus provision; breakeven expected 2029
items.quote: We have introduced accounting policy of sales cutoffs. So, the numbers that you see on the top line are after adjusting the revenue PUBLIC recognition of INR 5.6 crores, which is impacting EBITDA as well as we have started making the provision for founders’ bonus, which is to be paid next year in the month of May for 3 years, which is leading to this level of margin

items.statement: Geopolitical disruptions, input cost inflation (CPI 3.9%), monsoon impact on tractor demand, wind energy contract delays, FX volatility
items.quote: More challenges are visible on the horizon. We closely monitor the situation, and we are trying to be more agile in trying to handle the situations in a more proactive manner.

items.statement: Sales mix: Automotive Technologies 35% (includes e-mobility), Bearings & Industrial 35%, Vehicle Lifetime Solutions 12%, Exports 17%
items.quote: With this, the demography of our sales mix, 35% of our revenue comes from the Automotive Technologies. And here, the Automotive Technologies includes the e-mobility part of the business. The Bearings and Industrial Solutions brings in about 35% and the rest is split between Vehicle Lifetime Solutions, 12% and our exports, which is at about 17%.

items.statement: Zero PPM quality award from Toyota Kirloskar; awards from Voith Turbo, Sandvik Mining, John Deere, Denso India, Escorts Kubota
items.quote: What is also important and prestigious is to point out the zero PPM award for quality that we have received from one of the most stringent quality demanding customers, Toyota Kirloskar, and we received the award for a zero PPM.

items.statement: New Labor Codes implemented leading to wage cost increases; not recoverable from customers under indexation mechanism
items.quote: We did have some cost on the employee cost with the new Labor Codes coming in as well, the wage costs that have been implemented now and some of the other income expenses.

items.statement: Plant operated at over 90% utilization in Q1 FY27 and expects to continue above 90% in coming quarters
items.quote: During the past quarter, we operated the plant at an average capacity utilization of more than 90%, reflecting strong operating efficiency and ex pect to continue operating at more than 90% in the forthcoming quarters as well

items.statement: Global EAF steelmaking capacity additions of ~71 million tons planned by end-2028 support long-term electrode demand
items.quote: OECD steel outlook, which highlights that approximately 71 million tons of new electric arc furnace steelmaking capacity is planned globally for completion between now and end of 2028.

items.statement: Competitors announced price hikes of $600-$1,200/ton; HEG booked through next 1-2 quarters, price increases to flow from October
items.quote: We have seen 2 of our colleagues announcing fairly steep increases, the American company and a Japanese company. And obviously, their costs have also gone up, so have our costs gone up. And I think one of them has announced a price increase of between $600 to $1,200, depending on the size and quality. The other one has given one number of $930.

items.statement: Needle coke prices up $200-$300/ton due to Middle East disruptions; impact to hit P&L in 3-5 months due to inventory and processing cycle
items.quote: See, so far, I can't give a specific figure, but you can just take a ballpark number of between anywhere between $200, $250 or $300. That's the kind of increase we are now seeing because of this rise in oil prices and also increase in demand.

items.statement: Standalone EBITDA margin improved to 29% in Q1 FY27 from 23% YoY; management aims to maintain current margin levels
items.quote: Stand-alone EBITDA increased by 38% on a year-on-year basis to INR211 crores from INR154 crores, with EBITDA margins also improved to 29% compared with 23% in the corresponding quarter of last year.

items.statement: 70% of 20,000-ton anode capacity contracted with Tier-1 players; contracts to close in 1-1.5 months
items.quote: And almost about 70% of the contracts will be closed by the next 1, 1.5 months. And all these contracts will be long-term contracts with the top Tier 1 players across the world.

items.statement: HEG remains debt-free with INR858 crores treasury; Greentech (TACC) to carry INR1,500 crores gross debt post-demerger by March 2027
items.quote: So when this entire demerger exercise will completed and when you see 31st March '27 balance sheet, then there will be approximately around INR1,500 crores of debt lying on the company on a gross basis.

items.statement: Anode project capex INR2,200 crores: 40% spent, 90-95% to be spent by FY27, balance 10% in Q1 FY28
items.quote: Out of the entire INR2,200 crores, 40% is already been spent. The larger amount will be spent in next 3 quarters. And we are hoping that the entire 95% -- 90% payment will be done by FY '27 and balance 10% will be done in FY '28, first quarter.

items.statement: Anode project to start commercial production Q1 FY28 at 40-50% utilization, revenue INR600-700 crores Year 1, ramping to INR1,500-1,600 crores Year 3 with ~35% EBITDA margin
items.quote: For the a node project, it will start commercial production Q1 of next year. So we hope to operate at around 40% to 50% capacity utilization, which should give us a revenue of around INR600 crores to INR700 crores in the first year, which would ramp up to more than INR1,200 crores in year 2. An d in year 3, crossing around INR1,500 crores, INR1,600 crores

items.statement: US CVD preliminary results by end-July, anti-dumping by end-September; US exposure <10% of volumes
items.quote: CVD is by end July. Dumping is by end September. So we'll see what they come up with. We know that we have not done dumping. That is for sure.

items.statement: Exports ~70-75% of production; well diversified across 30+ countries; Middle East ~20% historically but only 3-4 countries impacted by shipping delays
items.quote: our exports continue to be in the region of 70%, 75%, which has been the case for not now, but last 25, 30 years. And we are practically exporting our electrodes to each part of the world to the smal lest countries sometimes in Africa, to Latin America, to the largest consuming country, which is U.S. and Europe

items.statement: New business bookings at higher prices; price hikes to cover 10-15% cost increase from energy, freight, needle coke
items.quote: However, in our existing markets, whether it's India or elsewhere, whatever new business we are booking are at higher prices. So we continue to gradually raise prices and our input costs are increasing and also needle coke prices are increasing.

items.statement: Company debt-free with INR858 crores treasury as of June 30, 2026; strong liquidity for growth opportunities
items.quote: Our balance sheet continues to remain one of our key strengths. The company remains debt-free with no long-term loan borrowings, and our treasury stood at approximately INR858 crores as of 30th June 2026.

items.statement: NCLT reserved order on composite scheme of arrangement; update on timeline and record date forthcoming; investor call planned post-order
items.quote: The NCLT has reserved its order and the company is awaiting pronouncement of the order. The company will provide an update shortly on the time line of effecting the scheme and the record date.

items.statement: Geopolitical tensions in Middle East driving higher freight, energy costs and raw material inflation; US trade policy changes disrupting global trade channels
items.quote: Various changes in the trade policy in several countries and the ongoing geopolitical tensions remain key sources of near-term uncertainty. Ch anges in U.S. trade policies, including tariffs and several country and product-specific measures are disrupting the established global trade channels

items.statement: Full-year FY27 presales growth guidance of 25% to 30% year-on-year
items.quote: we are confident overall in the full year, we will match our -- what we have given the guidance of 25% to 30% growth in our presales.

items.statement: Collections expected to grow 25% to 30% in FY27
items.quote: We'll see a similar growth, I would say, 25% to 30% growth in the presales also.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 presales of INR787 crores, up 20% year-on-year
items.quote: we sold INR787 crores worth of area in quarter 1 of FY27, which is a 20% growth over quarter 1 of FY26 presales of INR657 crores.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 collections of INR409 crores, up 17% year-on-year
items.quote: Collections for quarter 1 of FY27 stood at INR409 crores, a growth of 17% over INR351 crores in quarter 1 of FY'26.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin at 35%, up 9.5 percentage points year-on-year
items.quote: EBITDA margin stood at 35%.

items.statement: Embedded EBITDA margin on FY26 and Q1 FY27 presales in 35% to 40% range
items.quote: The embedded EBITDA margin on both our FY26 and Q1 of FY27 presales stands in the range of 35% to 40%.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 presales mix: Uber luxury 29%, premium luxury 50%, aspirational luxury 21%
items.quote: Uber luxury contributed 29%, premium luxury contributed 50% and aspirational luxury contributed 21% of the quarter's presales.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 business development and land capex of INR170 crores
items.quote: after deploying INR170 crores towards business development and land-related capital expenditure.

items.statement: Full-year FY27 business development spend expected to exceed FY26 spend of over INR800 crores
items.quote: we are looking to, in fact, surpass this number, looking at our strong balance sheet and the markets and what we are already under negotiation or in the advanced stage, we are looking to spend definitely this year also much more than the last year for getting into doing BD, more BD.

items.statement: To-be-launched GDV (ex-Dubai) of ~INR7,100 crores targeted for launch in FY27
items.quote: to-be launched GDV is close to 8,370 or 7,100 crores, sorry, 7,100 crores, close to. And which is like ODC, the additional tower in ODC, our Andheri redevelopment project near Western Express Highway, then what we are looking at Sunteck Park Mira Road 2, Mira Road 1 is already ongoing. So we'll be launching now -- looking to launch the new project, which we have acquired last year.

items.statement: Dubai project GDV of INR9,000 crores included in to-be-launched GDV; launch timing uncertain due to ongoing situation
items.quote: to-be launched GDV, if you go, that includes obviously 9,000 crores coming from Dubai projects. So if you remove that 9,000 crores, so to-be launched GDV is close to 8,370 or 7,100 crores, sorry, 7,100 crores, close to.

items.statement: Net debt to equity at 0.07x; AA long-term rating from India Ratings
items.quote: our net debt to equity remains negligible at 0.07x and our ratings, AA long-term rating from India Ratings, Fitch Group, remains among the strongest in Indian real estate.

items.statement: INR2,000+ crore fundraising resolution is enabling only; no immediate fundraising planned
items.quote: this is, obviously, enabling resolution. And if you see every year, we take this enabling resolution. So there is, as on today, if you ask me, there is absolutely no planning of any fundraising.

items.statement: FY27 delivery pipeline includes Sunteck OneWorld, additional floors in 4th Avenue, 1st Avenue, and Pinnacle
items.quote: this year, we are confident one, we will be delivering our project Sunteck OneWorld and maybe some more new floors in 4th Avenue. And there are some more new floors, which will be done on the 1st Avenue. So plus some additional floors even in Pinnacle.

items.statement: 5th Avenue ODC residential construction started; delivery targeted in 3 years; commercial construction to start soon, completion in 24-30 months
items.quote: 5th Avenue construction has already started residential. And we are, residential has already started. So we are looking to deliver that in three years from now. And you are asking about commercial. So commercial, we are looking to start very soon. And once we start there, we are targeting because it will be a spatial commercial. So we're looking to do complete that in 24 months, 24 months to 30 mo

items.statement: Net cash flow surplus of INR193 crores in Q1 FY27, up 79% year-on-year
items.quote: We generated a net cash flow surplus of INR193 crores during the quarter, a growth of 79% over quarter 1 FY26 after deploying INR170 crores towards business development and land-related capital expenditure.

items.statement: Trailing 12-month collections at ~INR1,500 crores
items.quote: if you see trailing months, if you see, our collections are close to 1,500 crores, which is again stronger than the past 12 months.

items.statement: Aspirational luxury growth driven by Naigaon and Kalyan projects; premium luxury driven by Sunteck City, Sunteck Sky Park, and SBR
